newsitem.title: USA: Empire State deck reopens after shooting.
newsitem.headline: Empire State deck reopens after shooting.

text.p: The observation deck of the Empire State Building reopened to the public on Tuesday with extensive new security measures, two days after a distraught gunman killed a tourist and wounded six others at the famous New York landmark.
Lines were long as hundreds of visitors waited to pass through metal detectors put in place in the wake of Sunday's shooting, when Ali Abu Kamal opened fire with a semiautomatic handgun.
The Palestinian gunman killed Danish rock musician Christoffer Burmeister and wounded six others before fatally shooting himself in the head.
Many of the visitors, who on Tuesday included the normal array of tour groups and schoolchildren, told reporters at the Empire State Building that they were not frightened after the deadly shooting.
Authorities at the landmark building also were examining visitors' bags, using machines similar to those at airports.
The added security added "just a few minutes" to the waiting time to get to the 86th floor observation deck, a trek generally slowed by waits for the lifts in the historic building, a spokesman said.
Lights on the top of the majestic building, which normally dominates the city's evening skyline, were turned off on Monday night in honour of the shooting victims.
